gains: frozen original common K/G, no redesign

schedules: private fixed schedule shape; its current value absent from attacker API

physical_fixtures: old seed-map indices0 and1 per model, deterministic unit/regression tests only
plans: tiny OL tamper for rejection counterexample
original_A0: never masked in place; protected-slot zeroing is separately named protected-timing-constrained waveform

normal_cost: exact deterministic availability covariance; realized pair errors are not probability estimates
